primary.title: Infosys ADR slips over 5% after Q1 results, FY27 growth guidance cut
primary.summary: Infosys ADR fell after the company reported a sequential drop in net profit for the first quarter of FY27 and a cut in the upper end of its FY27 revenue growth guidance.
